title: Magnificent Morocco: 7N Cultural Trail
tagline: Imperial cities, mountain passes, and a square that wakes up at sunset.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Casablanca (D)
itinerary.body: Meet our local representative, transfer to your hotel, and settle in with dinner in Casablanca.

itinerary.title: Casablanca to Rabat (1hr 15min)
itinerary.body: Visit Hassan II Mosque exterior, Mohamed V Square, Habbous Quarter, then continue to Rabat's Hassan Tower and Kasbah.

itinerary.title: Casablanca – Meknes – Fez (3hr 15min)
itinerary.body: Stop at Volubilis and Meknes before reaching Fez, Morocco's cultural capital.

itinerary.title: Full Day Exploration of Fez
itinerary.body: Walk Fez el-Bali, Medersas, Karaouine, Nejjarine Fountain, and artisan workshops.

itinerary.title: Fez – Beni Mellal – Marrakesh
itinerary.body: Cross the Middle Atlas through Ifrane and Beni Mellal before entering Marrakesh.

itinerary.title: Marrakesh sightseeing
itinerary.body: Explore Medersa Ben Youssef, Koutoubia, Bahia Palace, Menara Gardens, souks and Djemaa El Fna.

itinerary.title: Marrakesh to Casablanca
itinerary.body: A relaxed morning before the drive back to Casablanca for a farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Casablanca departure
itinerary.body: Transfer to Mohammed V International Airport for your flight home.

hotels.name: Riad Marjana Suites & Spa or similar
Le Kech Boutique Hotel & Spa or similar

inclusions: Private air-conditioned vehicle with English-speaking driver
fieldNotes: Carry small dirham notes in the medinas.
Friday afternoons run on prayer time.
The mint sprig at the Fez tannery is there for a reason.

title: Stairway to Heaven Switzerland 8N
tagline: Three lakes, two trains, alpine quiet.

itinerary.title: Zurich arrival
itinerary.body: Arrive, transfer, and walk the old town at leisure.

itinerary.title: Lucerne lakeside
itinerary.body: Bridge, lake, and optional Mount Titlis excursion.

itinerary.title: Interlaken and Jungfrau
itinerary.body: Rail into the Bernese Oberland for glacier views.

itinerary.title: Montreux finale
itinerary.body: Vineyards, lakefront drives, and a slow last dinner.

fieldNotes: Rail seats should be reserved in peak season.

title: Best of Kenya
tagline: Migration weeks in the Mara, designed around the sightings calendar.

itinerary.title: Nairobi arrival
itinerary.body: Meet your driver-guide and settle in after the flight.

itinerary.title: Lake Naivasha
itinerary.body: Boat safari and optional Crescent Island walk.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara
itinerary.body: Three nights of drives timed for light, crossings, and quiet corners.

fieldNotes: Migration sightings are natural, not scheduled.
Soft bags travel better than hard cases.

title: Iceland Ring of Wonders
tagline: Ring road, aurora, the lit dark.

itinerary.title: Reykjavik arrival
itinerary.body: Blue Lagoon option and city supper.

itinerary.title: South Coast
itinerary.body: Waterfalls, black-sand beaches, and basalt columns.

itinerary.title: Glacier lagoon
itinerary.body: Drive to Jokulsarlon and watch the ice drift.

title: France & Italy Discovery
tagline: Old cities, longer dinners, and two countries in one sweep.

itinerary.title: Paris
itinerary.body: Arrive into Paris and begin with a designer-led neighbourhood walk.

itinerary.title: Riviera
itinerary.body: Train south to Nice for markets, coastline and art stops.

itinerary.title: Italy finale
itinerary.body: Florence and Rome with private guides and unhurried dinners.

fieldNotes: Museum slots should be secured early.
August changes the rhythm of both countries.

title: Beautiful Bali Luxury Multi-Hotel
tagline: Overwater villas, warm tides, and the kind of quiet you only find at sea.

itinerary.title: Ubud arrival
itinerary.body: Check into the hills and begin with a quiet dinner.

itinerary.title: Water temples
itinerary.body: Visit Tirta Empul, rice terraces, and artisan villages.

itinerary.title: Coast finale
itinerary.body: Move to the beach for slower days and sunset dinners.

fieldNotes: Traffic is part of Bali; plan around it.
Temple visits need covered shoulders and knees.
